architecture.title: System Architecture & Subsystems
architecture.description: Byte is built on a four-layer hybrid Machine Learning architecture operating natively and 100% offline on macOS.

behaviors.title: Behavior Repertoire
behaviors.description: This document details the concrete list of actions Byte can perform. Each of these is a candidate action that the Utility AI (detailed in the State Engine) can select.

empathy-ml-pipeline.title: Empathy AI & ML Fine-Tuning Pipeline
empathy-ml-pipeline.description: Byte's emotional intelligence is driven by a dedicated Machine Learning pipeline designed for Apple Silicon GPUs and Ollama deployment.

installation-guide.title: Installation & Quickstart
installation-guide.description: This guide walks you through setting up and running Byte on your Mac.

sensors-and-os.title: Sensors & OS Integration
sensors-and-os.description: Byte uses native macOS APIs to passively monitor the system and environment without polling. All sensor data is passed to the State Engine to gently nudge internal variables. Sensors never call rendering or emotion resolution directly.

state-engine.title: State Engine & Emotions
state-engine.description: At the core of Byte's personality is the State Engine (implemented in plain Swift), operating at a ~10Hz tick. Unlike traditional game characters that rely on rigid dispatch tables (event → animation), Byte's behavior and emotions emerge dynamically from continuously evaluating internal variables.
